name: The Laguna
positioning: The Laguna, a Luxury Collection Resort & Spa: a beachfront resort in Nusa Dua, Bali, built around seven lagoon pools and tropical gardens, with Balinese-inspired rooms and villas
best_for: Travelers who want rooms with direct lagoon access steps from the beach
Couples seeking a spa with an ocean-view treatment gazebo
Families interested in Balinese cultural activities for kids

facts.text: The resort is set along the shores of Nusa Dua, with seven lagoons flowing through tropical gardens that extend to the beachfront.
The resort has seven lagoon-shaped swimming pools.
Waterfalls greet guests from the lobby as the lagoon stretches to the beach; there are two sandy beaches, a dedicated pool area and two jacuzzis.
Rooms feature traditional Balinese decor such as woven keben baskets, used to carry offerings at temples, and low-rise dulang tables with local tropical fruits.
Specially commissioned artwork in the rooms pays tribute to the island's arts and crafts.
The villas have marble bathrooms and butler service.
Pool villas each have their own expansive private pool, and a 24-hour butler service is offered.
The Lagoon Spa offers Balinese massages with coconut oil.
Trinity Courts offers tennis, padel and pickleball amid tropical gardens.
Kids' activities inspired by Bali's indigenous heritage include natural batik printing, the traditional Deduplak game and clay bottle painting.
Arwana is a beachfront grill restaurant whose Basque grills flame-cook seafood and dry-aged meats.
The resort is a Green Key-certified establishment.

highlights.text: Rooms offer views of fragrant gardens from private balconies or direct access to the lagoon's warm waters; in a Lagoon Access Room guests can step from the private balcony directly into the water.
The Lagoon Spa has indoor treatment rooms, a treatment gazebo overlooking the Indian Ocean and a private relaxation lounge with steam and sauna.
On the white sand beach, cabanas offer shade and beachside wellness treatments.
Guests can take part in a Balinese blessing ceremony, and a daily Jamu Ritual is held at 6pm in de Bale Lounge & Bar.
Guests can explore Kedonganan fish market accompanied by the resort's chef.

considerations.text: The airport is 11 km from the property.
WhataHotel notes it is a large resort property where facilities are spread out.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing typical of luxury beachfront resorts.
